stimuli.description: Two virtual building models (Sustainable Building - SB and Conventional Building - CB) with manipulated lighting, views, and spatial arrangement.
5-minute video walkthroughs of the SB and CB designs.
45 still images for each of the SB and CB designs, showing key points along the walkthrough path.

limitations: Building parameters (lighting, spatial dimensions, nature views) were assessed together, not isolated.
Different space types (private vs. public) were assessed together, not isolated.
Only one primary built environment was assessed, limiting generalizability of specific parameter effects.
Study measured only short-term effects in a virtual environment, not long-term real-world impacts.
Uncertainty if short-term virtual environment effects are representative of long-term real-world impacts.
